title: T(r)opical Islands: Visualizing & Understanding Socio-Technical Artifacts
abstract: arXiv:2609.05254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Projects hosted on collaborative software development platforms, such as GitHub, include many non-code artifacts documenting the project's lifecycle, with its challenges, plans, design, and even community. These socio-technical artifacts include, for example, bug reports, feature requests, and forum posts, offering a useful prospect on the project's evolution. However, these artifacts are dispersed over multiple communication channels and written in natural language, making their analysis difficult, as they are fragmented and with considerable noise.   We present a 3D visualization approach mapping topics found across a project's socio-technical artifacts onto vegetation-covered islands, where the individual artifacts are depicted as trees of various types. translated_title: T(r)opical之岛（主题/热带双关）：可视化与理解社会技术工件
translated_abstract: 托管在GitHub等协作软件开发平台上的项目包含大量记录项目生命周期的非代码工件，其中涵盖项目面临的挑战、计划、设计乃至社区情况。这些社会技术工件包括错误报告、功能请求和论坛帖子等，为观察项目的演变提供了有价值的视角。然而，这些工件分散在多个沟通渠道中，且以自然语言书写，其碎片化和大量噪音使得分析变得困难。我们提出了一种3D可视化方法，将项目社会技术工件中发现的主题映射到覆盖着植被的岛屿上，各个工件被描绘为不同类型的树木。主题岛屿随着被讨论而从海面升起，不再被讨论时则重新沉入海底。我们构建了一个实现完整可视化管线的原型系统。
tldr: 本文提出一种3D可视化方法，将软件项目的社会技术工件（如错误报告、功能请求、论坛帖子等）按主题映射为覆盖植被的热带岛屿，主题岛屿随讨论热度起伏沉浮，从而帮助理解和分析碎片化且充满噪音的项目沟通数据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a 3D visualization approach that maps topics from a project's socio-technical artifacts (such as bug reports, feature requests, and forum posts) onto vegetation-covered islands that rise and sink with discussion activity, facilitating the analysis of fragmented and noisy project communications.
